_note: Span-of-control calibration defaults by work archetype, per the B1 skill spec: a single universal band conflates a call-centre supervisor with a project director, and flags whichever one the band wasn't tuned for. A role matching none of these keeps the organisation's flat band from span-thresholds.json (the professional/knowledge-work default) rather than an invented one.
_matching: Matched on title first, then function group, in the order listed below — first match wins. Keywords of three characters or fewer must appear as whole words (so 'coo' doesn't match inside a longer word), longer keywords match as a substring. flagUnder/flagOver, where given, are the actual thin/wide boundary; healthyMin/healthyMax describe the ideal band shown alongside it. matchFunctionGroups is deliberately unused for now — a whole function group (e.g. 'Operations') is too coarse a signal for a supervision-style archetype and would reclassify unrelated managers alongside the ones it's meant for; it stays available for a later phase with a sharper signal (e.g. role/site data).
